findings.evidence_observed: Synthetic Sentinel configuration excerpt shows interactive retention tier, not immutable archive.
findings.recommended_next_step: Reconfigure archive retention, export before and after evidence, then update the SSP claim.
findings.risk: A reviewer can identify a direct mismatch between the narrative and the evidence artifact.
findings.ssp_claim: SSP states audit records are retained in immutable storage.

findings.evidence_observed: Synthetic allowlist exists, but last review date is 11 months old.
findings.recommended_next_step: Restart monthly allowlist review and preserve three consecutive review records.
findings.risk: The control narrative claims a cadence that the provided record does not support.
findings.ssp_claim: External system connections are allowlisted and reviewed monthly.

findings.evidence_observed: No tabletop record, after-action report, attendee list, or exercise artifact included in the synthetic packet.
findings.recommended_next_step: Run and document an incident response tabletop before formal review.
findings.risk: A claimed annual test has no supporting artifact in the packet.
findings.ssp_claim: Incident response plan is tested annually.

findings.evidence_observed: Synthetic scope summary identifies MSP inheritance assumptions but no signed customer responsibility matrix.
findings.recommended_next_step: Produce an MSP customer responsibility matrix and map inherited controls to owner, artifact, and cadence.
findings.risk: Inherited-control ownership is not clear enough for a clean pre-review conversation.
findings.ssp_claim: Shared responsibility with the MSP is understood and inherited controls are identified.

first_real_customer_receipt_definition.customer_data_rule: No customer data appears in a public receipt without written approval and redaction review.
first_real_customer_receipt_definition.receipt_name: Design Partner CMMC Evidence Packet QA Receipt

limitations: This is a synthetic public demo packet created for verification exercise only. It is not customer evidence and should not be used as a live assessment artifact.
Hardseal provides pre-review evidence integrity support. Hardseal does not certify compliance, does not make final assessment determinations, and does not replace an authorized third-party assessor.

operational_class is edge-inference-verification so the existing browser and Python verifier can validate this packet without modification; the CMMC packet QA evidence is carried in benchmark.packet_qa. Benchmark latency and throughput fields are zeroed because no inference workload ran.

what a PASS proves: the packet is internally consistent under the Hardseal Edge v1.0 hash-chain rules; benchmark.packet_qa.finding_chain_root is the recomputable append-only chain over the included synthetic findings. What it does not prove: that any real organization has these facts, that any system meets CMMC or NIST SP 800-171 requirements, or any assessor outcome.
